relationships.evidence_quote: strong expression for CB2 was detected in the epithelial cells of the endometriotic lesions in ovaries with endometriosis

relationships.subject: epithelial cells of ovarian endometriotic lesions
relationships.evidence_quote: Epithelial cells of the endometriotic glands in ovaries with endometriosis showed intense staining for CB1

key_findings: CB1 and CB2 protein and CNR1/CNR2 mRNA are higher in epithelium of ovarian endometriotic lesions than in surrounding stroma or normal ovary.
Findings suggest endometriotic lesions may respond to cannabinoids for pain.
